detail.longDescription: Before GPU passthrough on Proxmox, check the IOMMU group and arrange a recovery console that doesn't depend on that GPU. Passing a whole GPU to a VM makes it unavailable to the host. For Jellyfin or Ollama, check whether container device access is enough before committing the card to a VM. https:// techfuelhq.com/tutorials/gpu-p assthrough-proxmox-vm-2026/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=distribution-2026-10&utm_content=passthrough-checks # Proxmox # SelfHosted
